toegepas.na: bly daar net poele water oor
toegepas.rede_vinder: The existential 'daar' makes 'bly ... oor' read naturally; without it the sentence sounds clipped.
toegepas.fout: With an indefinite subject ('poele water') after the inverted verb, Afrikaans naturally wants existential 'daar'; without it the clause reads clipped.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'daar' makes the clause natural Afrikaans without changing who, what or when, and no protected wording is touched.

laat_vaar.voor: Die pad wat mense van een plek na 'n ander volg.
laat_vaar.na: Die pad wat mense volg om van een plek na 'n ander te kom.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting 'volg' after 'van een plek na 'n ander' is awkward; the purpose clause reads more naturally and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original glossary definition is correct, natural Afrikaans word order, so the proposal is a lateral move on a definition that only changes through the writer.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Rigting kry' echoes English 'get your bearings'; 'rigting bepaal' is the idiomatic Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.fout: 'jou rigting te kry' echoes English 'get your bearings'; Afrikaans would say 'jou rigting bepaal' or 'koers kry'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but it sits inside a glossary definition, which only the writer may reword across all lessons that share it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.na: Op die roetes daarheen was daar
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'hierdie roetes' points back to routes the lesson has not yet named; 'die roetes daarheen' ties them to the journey just described, and the protected phrase is untouched.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hierdie roetes' points clearly enough to the inland-to-coast journey just described; 'daarheen' is a lateral move that also narrows the routes to one direction.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: 'n Lang pad te voet vra elke dag water en kos.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Wie lank te voet reis, het elke dag water en kos nodig.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A road that 'asks for' water and food is wooden personification; the rewrite says the same thing naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'vra' in the sense of 'demands' is idiomatic Afrikaans, so the original reads well and the rewrite is only different.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Siekte, ver van hulp by die huis.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Siekte, ver van die huis en van hulp.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'ver van hulp by die huis' can be misread as being far from help while at home; the rewrite makes clear the traveller is far from home and its help.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original reads naturally as far from the help at home, while the proposal widens it to far from any help, which moves the meaning.
